title: Nisar Ahamad v. State of U.P.
coram: Shekhar B. Saraf, J.; Praveen Kumar Giri, J.
disposition: Dismissed as withdrawn with liberty to approach Supply Code authority.
headnote: Writ petition dismissed as withdrawn, with liberty to the petitioner to approach the authority under the Uttar Pradesh Electricity Supply Code in accordance with law. The Court did not examine the electricity dispute on merits.
facts: Nisar Ahamad filed Writ-C No. 23348 of 2025 in the High Court of Judicature at Allahabad against the State of Uttar Pradesh and another. Counsel for respondent no. 2 appeared through a holding brief. At the hearing on 28 July 2025, counsel for the petitioner sought leave to withdraw the writ petition with liberty to approach the authority under the Uttar Pradesh Electricity Supply Code, in accordance with law. The order does not describe the underlying connection, billing, or supply dispute.

holding_units.topic: withdrawal with liberty to Supply Code authority
holding_units.holding: On the petitioner's request, the writ petition is dismissed as withdrawn with liberty to approach the authority under the Uttar Pradesh Electricity Supply Code in accordance with law.
